architecture.iNaiHR: propose HORN / DUAL_HORN / AFFINE_SCC / FEEDBACK_CIRCUIT views
architecture.JANUS_GATE: independent witness, Tear and reduction verification

positive_result: Horn and dual-Horn modules compose exactly in O(2^k poly(L)); affine cyclic SCCs admit polynomial GF(2) witnesses or conflict Tears.
obstruction: Every exact 3-clause is Horn or dual-Horn, so clause-wise tractable-language coverage already contains arbitrary 3-SAT. A linear-size constrained nonlinear feedback network is satisfiable exactly when its source 3-CNF is satisfiable.

surviving_conjecture.name: Polynomial Semantic Interface Selector Conjecture
surviving_conjecture.statement: For every CNF of length L, one deterministic polynomial-time Observer constructs a proof-carrying network of tractable modules and SCC solvers whose total interface-state, proof, selection and witness-recovery volume is poly(L).

distance_to_p_equals_np: The mathematical status is unchanged. The missing resource is narrowed from language selection to language composition with universally controlled semantic-interface complexity.
hard_boundaries: No clause-language vote is accepted as a proof.
No 2^k interface enumeration is called polynomial unless k=O(log L).
No cyclic SCC is treated as a uniquely eliminable definition without a certificate.
No textual substitution is used when a shared DAG representation exists.
A general solver for the constrained-feedback class would already solve 3-SAT.
